statement:
I'll look up the payment details first, then handle it according to the cancellation record.
The record shows the membership as active and renewing for another year, but Tomas cancelled the membership in writing on July 3rd and received email confirmation from the club.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the record's status is incorrect: "The record shows the membership as active and renewing... but Tomas cancelled the membership in writing on July 3rd and received email confirmation."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
